blocking: Mobile navigation becomes inaccessible if site.js fails: the inline script adds .js, CSS hides the links, and the menu button has no working handler.

fixes.what: Collapse navigation only under .nav-ready; keep a usable navigation fallback until handlers are successfully attached.
fixes.why: A failed script request currently removes access to all three inner pages on mobile.

fixes.what: Replace unconditional top:30% with positioning that accounts for the rendered logo, descriptor and tag height; verify clearance at 390px in short viewports and with enlarged text.
fixes.why: The desktop clearance constraint is discarded on phones; heroDrift() cannot repair an existing text/art intersection.

fixes.what: Move the mobile flex and margin overrides after the base .nav-home rule so flex:0 1 120px and margin-right:0 actually apply.
fixes.why: The later base rule overrides both intended mobile safeguards, leaving the logo unable to shrink in a crowded header.

fixes.where: assets/js/site.js — expandable details and ScrollTrigger measurements
fixes.what: Observe relevant content-size changes or listen for details toggle events, then schedule a ScrollTrigger refresh and Lenis resize.
fixes.why: Expanding service inclusions changes the positions of the entire five-step timeline without updating its scroll measurements.

fixes.what: Create one reusable shake timeline inside the context and restart it for each qualifying flick.
fixes.why: Each flick currently adds another timeline to the long-lived context; clearing shakeTl does not remove the context's retained reference.

fixes.what: Allow vertical resizing with resize:vertical while retaining the minimum height.
fixes.why: The fixed message box makes longer inquiries unnecessarily difficult to review and edit.
